import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 12, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786" row_colors = ["#33658A", "#2A9D8F", "#D4A72C", "#9273B5"]
# Verify the supplied forward transform and its normalization. F4 = np.array([ [1, 1, 1, 1], [1, -1j, -1, 1j], [1, -1, 1, -1], [1, 1j, -1, -1j], ], dtype=complex) if not np.allclose(F4.conj().T @ F4, 4 * np.eye(4)): raise ValueError("The supplied DFT matrix does not satisfy F_4^H F_4 = 4 I_4.")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 4), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 960) ax.set_ylim(0, 400) ax.axis("off")
def text(x, y, label, size=14, color=ink, ha="center", weight="normal"): return ax.text( x, y, label, fontsize=size, color=color, ha=ha, va="center", fontweight=weight, )
def brackets(left, right, bottom, top, color=ink, linewidth=1.25): cap = 6 ax.plot( [left + cap, left, left, left + cap], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=color, lw=linewidth, solid_capstyle="butt", ) ax.plot( [right - cap, right, right, right - cap], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=color, lw=linewidth, solid_capstyle="butt", )
# A single quiet divider separates the forward and inverse constructions. ax.plot([486, 486], [48, 365], color="#E5EAE8", lw=1)
text(30, 354, "Forward DFT as Matrix Multiplication", size=13, ha="left", weight="medium") text(30, 314, r"$X = F_4\,x$", size=20, ha="left")
text(520, 354, "Inverse DFT via Conjugate Transpose", size=13, ha="left", weight="medium") text(520, 314, r"$F_4^{-1}=\frac{1}{4}\,F_4^H$", size=20, ha="left")
ys = [250, 215, 180, 145]
# Explicit forward matrix equation. brackets(43, 86, 126, 269) for k, y in enumerate(ys): text(64.5, y, rf"$X_{k}$", size=17) text(108, 197.5, r"$=$", size=18)
entries = [ ["1", "1", "1", "1"], ["1", "-i", "-1", "i"], ["1", "-1", "1", "-1"], ["1", "i", "-1", "-i"], ] brackets(134, 353, 126, 269) for row, y, color in zip(entries, ys, row_colors): for x, entry in zip([159, 215, 271, 327], row): text(x, y, f"${entry}$", size=18, color=color) text(243.5, 288, r"$F_4$", size=13, color=slate) text(373, 197.5, r"$\cdot$", size=18) brackets(394, 437, 126, 269) for k, y in enumerate(ys): text(415.5, y, rf"$x_{k}$", size=17)
text(30, 83, "Rows of " + r"$F_4$" + ": conjugate-transposed basis vectors", size=10.5, ha="left", color=slate) for k, (x, color) in enumerate(zip([73, 183, 293, 403], row_colors)): text(x, 51, rf"$u_{k}^H$", size=16, color=color)
# Orthogonality produces the unnormalized identity, hence the inverse factor. text(519, 197.5, r"$F_4^H F_4 =$", size=17, ha="left") brackets(635, 806, 126, 269) for i, y in enumerate(ys): for j, x in enumerate([656, 699, 742, 785]): text(x, y, "$4$" if i == j else "$0$", size=17) text(823, 197.5, r"$=4I_4$", size=18, ha="left")
text(520, 69, "Therefore", size=11, color=slate, ha="left") text(623, 69, r"$x=\frac{1}{4}\,F_4^H X$", size=21, ha="left")
